brand.name: MORZÉA
brand.category: Luxury Moroccan Beauty & Hammam Ritual House
brand.root: Rooted in Moroccan beauty rituals and provenance
brand.promise: Authentic Moroccan ritual elevated with precision.
brand.origin_principle: Origin is not decoration. Origin is proof.

name_story.summary: MORZÉA is a coined proprietary name. MOR intentionally opens toward Morocco/origin; ZÉA is a lyrical proprietary ending expressing movement, femininity and transformation.
name_story.never_claim: Never present MORZÉA as an ancient or historical name for Morocco.

02.claim_status: Textile composition, place of manufacture and origin claims require approved production sample and supplier declaration.

03.name: Organic Moroccan Argan Oil
03.role: Closing cosmetic oil step; a few drops pressed onto clean, slightly damp skin.
03.claim_status: Organic, Moroccan-origin, purity and extraction-method claims require recognized certification and final product documentation.

claims_policy: Do not publish unverified origin, purity, organic, clinical, sustainability or efficacy claims.
Do not claim MORZÉA is a historical Moroccan word/name.
Do not position cosmetics as medical treatment.
Use 'Authentic Moroccan', 'Made in Morocco', '100% Pure Argan Oil', 'Organic', 'Cold Pressed' or equivalent SKU claims only when final evidence supports them.
For medical or dermatological conditions, provide general cosmetic information only and recommend professional advice when appropriate.

approved_brand_story.ar: MORZÉA دار جمال سعودية التأسيس، مغربية الجذور، تعيد تقديم طقوس الحمّام والعناية المغربية ضمن تجربة معاصرة تقوم على الأصل والحرفة واللمس.
approved_brand_story.en: MORZÉA is a Saudi-founded beauty house devoted to Moroccan ritual. The house begins with origin, craft and ingredient, then elevates each step through modern design, precise education and a sensorial experience made to be repeated.
